subject.title: feat(sidebar): add Session Reset button alongside New Session

question: Should the Control UI expose a first-class destructive Reset session button beside New session, rather than keeping reset as the existing command-level action?
rationale: This adds a new visible session-state control and overlaps an open broader reset-feature discussion; implementation quality alone cannot establish the intended product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the sidebar action
options.body: Approve the direction contingent on a current-main rebase, locale regeneration, and proof that reset clears only the active transcript while preserving its session key.

options.title: Keep reset command-only
options.body: Decline the additional sidebar control and retain the existing reset path until a broader session-management design is chosen.

options.title: Fold into broader session work
options.body: Pause this PR and decide the UI action together with the broader reset and bulk-management request.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the sidebar action
recommendation.body: Approve the direction contingent on a current-main rebase, locale regeneration, and proof that reset clears only the active transcript while preserving its session key.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature ownership could not be established without the required repository history read.
